verdict.rationale: WezTerm is locally installed software (brew cask install), not a hosted service, so the whole product runs on infrastructure the user controls. Its multiplexer server can be run on your own local or remote hosts over SSH domains. A hands-on probe confirmed `wezterm-mux-server --daemonize` running headless and fully controllable via `wezterm cli`. Missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license or build-from-source path, and server-side install/deployment docs for remote mux hosts beyond macOS brew.
